quest.title: For an Ice Mirror Fragment
quest.description: You find notes left behind by someone who was lost in the snowy mountains... Is he still alive? Is there still time for you to save his life...?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, there's no one in the tent, but not much snow buildup either...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How would even come here, anyway? How strange...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this? An adventure notebook?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "The blizzard plastered itself to my face like a mask, almost sealing my eyes shut. I could not find the homeward way, let alone a path to the House of Hesperides..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Fortunately, I was able to find a cave to avoid the storm, but my stocks of food are bottoming out... Perhaps I should never have... No. No. This is a trial set before me. It must be."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "I must reach the mansion and meet the great lady... I must witness true Prime Ice artisanship."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "But how will I get out of here? Perhaps I can continue to explore this cave first..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Hmm. I think I've gotten used to the temperature in here. Everything's starting to warm up just a little..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, is this person okay? Seems like he's frozen so bad, he's starting to hallucinate.

choices.text: Well, he did warm up, didn't he?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, you know that feeling warm in a snowy place like this is the last thing you wanna have happen!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: According to his notes, he's proceeding through this cave... Let's go on ahead as well. Can't be sure if he can still be saved, though...

choices.text: The situation does seem quite serious...

talks.objective: Help the person in the icy cave

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good thing we didn't fall straight into the water...

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: Ohh, b—be careful... This ice block's starting to move...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, we'll get you outta here.

talks.objective: Drift on the glacier until you reach the shore

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: *panting* ... Oh, Tsaritsa be praised... Scared me to death there... If I'd fallen into the water, that would've been the end of me.

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: Thanks, you two. I'm Martos... Sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are you apologizing?

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: ...I wanted to tell you that that block of ice wasn't at all solid, but I just... couldn't get the words out while I was up there. I can't say why.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, you were probably just feeling a bit too weak, y'know? Anyway, feeling better now?

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: Yes, much better. Thanks to you two, to be honest... Um, might I know your names?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You introduce yourselves to Martos.

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon... I see.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...That said, Martos, what brings you here at all, out in the ice and snow?

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: Prime Ice Sculpting. That's what I came here to learn...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Prime Ice Sculpting?

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: That's right! *cough* I was headed to the House of Hesperides. Its owner is the Duchess of the Snegovik, one exceedingly skilled at this art...

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: Many a masterpiece was created by her hand, even the snowflake at the heart of the Zapolyarny Palace plaza and the sculptures made in the likeness of crystal ores that stand before the ducal mansion of Novokitezhgrad...

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: Humans cannot call upon Prime Ice as the fae do... but we can learn to use hammer and chisel to bring forth similar beauty.

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: Thanks to you two, I'm one step closer to the mansion!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you're still going up the mountain, then?

dialogues.speaker: Maltus
dialogues.text: Well, I'm here already, aren't I? It would be such a shame to turn back now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But...

choices.text: I won't stop you from continuing on, but wait for the blizzard to die down a bit.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You help him start a fire here and give him a share of your food and water.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you've had something to eat and drink, and you're all warmed up, too. Now you're good to go!

response.speaker: Maltus
response.text: If I do indeed learn this art, I will surely, surely make you a great sculpture!

choices.text: Remember to make me a bit taller, eh...

response.speaker: Maltus
response.text: Hahaha, don't worry! I'm sure my work will be more than satisfactory!

choices.text: Remember to make Paimon somewhat cuter...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whaddya mean "somewhat cuter"? Paimon's cute right now!

choices.text: Make sure you rest up before you leave, alright?
